_: Candidate-selection parameters for S2. Derived and verified in rdtii-finale-3-mapping/notes/2026-09-26-selection-cap-function.md against the Round 1 reference arm: 7,864 candidate pairs per economy against 13,627 for the fixed caps it replaces, gold recall 37/37 unchanged, 0 of 27 economy scores changed, 120 of 135 filed evidence rows retained. Settings, not code: tunable after the 30 September freeze.

score._: theta is an absolute cosine threshold against the indicator's query document. It is comparable across indicators and economies: every Round 1 filed row scored >= 0.540, while random provisions average 0.379-0.406 and top out at 0.51.
score._direct_band: At or above this score a candidate goes straight to the mapper; between theta and this it gets the cheap triage screen first. Replaces GRAY_MULT = 3.

language_offset._: Added to theta. Measured 2026-09-26 by scoring the same provision as source text and as an English gloss, 20 paired provisions per language across 4 indicator queries. Negative lowers the threshold. The gloss is machine-made, which biases these toward zero, so treat them as lower bounds; the 53 Lao laws with publisher English would settle Lao.
language_offset._default_note: Unmeasured language: take the largest measured offset, which is the conservative direction.

class_defaults._: For an indicator with no measured density, such as the 52 outside pillars 6 and 7. Assign the class from the codebook: level == economy -> horizontal_instrument; binary [1,0] scoring with a duty that recurs across sectoral statutes -> recurring_duty; a duty defined by its subject matter -> subject_specific; prohibition phrasing that also appears in secrecy provisions -> prohibition.

6.1.note: Worst precision in the pipeline: 2,134 candidates per filed row, because transfer-prohibition phrasing pervades banking-secrecy provisions. Depth cannot fix that; the mapper's conditional_path_exists trap does. Ceiling is high because Australia's only ban row sat at dense rank 1,635, and because 6.1 is the cell most likely to fire in China.

6.2.note: Dense finds these at median rank 19; BM25 at 935. Deepest filed row 481.

6.3.note: Produced no traceable filed row in three economies; density 0.22%. theta binds, so the cell is cheap and its null result is still evidenced.

6.4.note: Deepest filed row 36. BM25 median rank 7 - the phrase 'except in accordance' is literal, which is why this indicator keeps a sparse top-up.

7.1.note: theta deliberately loose so the ceiling selects. A theta of 0.58 would recover gold row r1-sg-039 (Banking Act 1970 s.47, best provision 0.594) with a margin of only +0.014 - a threshold fitted to one row. One filed row per economy.

7.2.note: Economy-level like 7.1, but 'cybersecurity' language is widespread: density 2.57%. Deepest filed row 390.

7.3.note: Densest indicator at 13.79% of the corpus; filed rows come from 31 distinct laws. Binary scoring, so the cell scores 1 on the first verified instance and the tail adds rows, not score. Its BM25 tail beats its dense tail, hence the sparse top-up.

7.4.note: Cheapest cell in the pipeline: 27 candidates per filed row, density 0.09%, deepest row 73.

7.5.note: Deepest filed row 2,480 - the tail is unreachable at any affordable ceiling. Binary scoring, same saturation argument as 7.3. Two of its filed rows fall outside BM25's top 50,000 entirely.

economy_overrides._: Per (economy, indicator) overrides of any field above. Empty by design: add entries on 15 October when the sealed task names an economy, or when one jurisdiction proves denser than its class. Example shape: "CN": { "6.1": { "max_candidates": 2400 } }
economy_overrides._measured: IN-SAMPLE. Added 2026-09-27. Each of these four values was chosen after observing where a specific 2025-baseline row ranked in that cell, so they are fitted, not measured: a recall figure computed WITH them is in-sample and must be reported as such. Decision M15 in the mapping workspace sets what we publish -- selection recall 56/63 = 88.9%, the figure computed with these overrides cleared; 61/63 = 96.8% disclosed separately and labelled. Kept because each cell is independently anomalous in a way the ranks below document, and because removing them now would invalidate 21,175 triaged pairs; replaced, not re-tuned, by the M14 experiment, which fits threshold, cap and embedder together after the deadline. Only ceilings and floors were moved -- theta, the relevance decision, was never touched by any of them.

7.1._: IN-SAMPLE (see _measured). Ceiling 400 -> 600. Why this cell is anomalous, independent of any baseline row: 2,109 of Singapore's 10,370 rows in this cell clear theta 0.550, so a 400 ceiling silently overrode the threshold for 1,709 rows that had already passed it -- the sectoral banking-secrecy tail is genuinely long here. What makes the VALUE fitted: 600 was chosen to clear rank 538, where gold r1-sg-039 (Banking Act 1970 s.47, cosine 0.594) sits. A rule-based ceiling for this cell would be >= 2,109, not 600.

7.5._: IN-SAMPLE (see _measured). Ceiling -> 3,800. Why this cell is anomalous, independent of any baseline row: ALL 3,747 of China's rows in this cell clear theta 0.560, because government-access language is pervasive in Chinese law. The cell is legitimately deep rather than noisy, and 3,800 takes the whole of it, leaving the gray band to screen it. This is the one override whose value a gold-free rule -- 'admit every row above theta' -- reproduces. What makes it fitted anyway: the cell was examined because gold r2-cn-067 and r2-cn-070 sit at ranks 2,302 and 3,416 (cosines 0.588, 0.575).

6.2._: IN-SAMPLE (see _measured), and the most clearly fitted of the four. Floor -> 800. Why the cell is anomalous, independent of any baseline row: only 571 Chinese rows clear theta 0.570, so the threshold finds little and the floor is the honest knob for how deep to go. What makes the VALUE fitted: 800 was chosen to clear rank 798, where gold r2-cn-043 (Map Management Regulations, cosine 0.563) sits -- seven thousandths BELOW theta. Nothing but that rank distinguishes 800 from 600 or 1,000. Measured cost 227 pairs.

7.4._: IN-SAMPLE (see _measured), and the value is fitted. Floor -> 600, ceiling -> 700. Why the cell is anomalous, independent of any baseline row: only 148 Chinese rows clear theta 0.600. What makes the VALUE fitted: 560 is where gold r2-cn-065 (Cybersecurity Law, cosine 0.568) sits, and the ceiling moved with the floor because 500 would have cut before it. Measured 2026-09-27: this override does NOT recover the row's evidence anyway -- rank 560 is Art. 73, a penalties article, which triage correctly refused; the article carrying the duty (Art. 21, cosine 0.561) is at rank 782, outside 700. The cosine band here spans 0.568 to 0.556 across 400 ranks, so the ordering carries no signal and no ceiling fixes it. See decision M14. Measured cost 412 pairs.
